entities.summary: LabWindows/CVI is an ANSI C programming environment for test and measurement developed by National Instruments. The program was originally released as LabWindows for DOS in 1987, but was soon revisioned for the Microsoft Windows platform. The current version of LabWindows/CVI is 2020.
